خط‌مشی کیفیت اطلس سندی رسمی و کنترل‌شده: The Atlas quality policy is a formal, controlled document approved by the Managing Director and communicated to every employee. Its four main commitments:
الزامات مشتری، الزامات قانونی و مقرراتی،: Customer requirements, legal and regulatory requirements, industry standards and contractual obligations.

شرکت مدیریت صنعتی اطلس متعهد است با تکیه: Atlas Industrial Management is committed to producing high-quality, safe and reliable parts and services for core industries, drawing on specialist knowledge, appropriate technology, controlled and traceable processes, and the active participation of all our people.

مدیریت ارشد، منابع لازم برای استقرار، نگ: Top management provides the resources needed to establish, maintain and ensure the effectiveness of the quality management system, sets measurable quality objectives and reviews their performance regularly. This policy is communicated to, understood and applied by all employees, and is the basis for continual improvement of the quality management system, reducing waste and nonconformities, on-time delivery and the company's sustainable growth.
